title: Ibyokurya bitunguranye by'Umusaza
intro: Mu busitani butagatifu bw'Ingoro ya Allah, umugaragu w'Imana ugeze mu za bukuru yahuye n'ibanga rikomeye ryarenze ibyo yari yiteze byose. Uyu muntu w'indahemuka, wari umaze imyaka myinshi y'ububyeyi karemano, yabonye ikintu kidasanzwe cyahishuye imbabazi zitagira imipaka z'Imana. Ikibazo kiri mu guhishura iki gihe cyibagiranye mu buzima bw'abahanuzi.
clues: Ubwoko bwanjye bwari buzwi nka Isirayeli, urubyaro rw'umukurambere ukomeye wo mu gihe cya kera.
Namaze amajoro yanjye nsenga, nkubita ibirenge imbere y'Umwami wanjye mu rusengero.
Nahawe umwana w'umuhungu mu zabukuru, impano ntahwemye gusingiza Imana.
Ikigeragezo cyanjye cyasabaga kubona ibitunga umuntu ukiri muto wari uhari.
Nari umuhanuzi witwaga Zakariya, nshinzwe kwita kuri Mariyamu muri Bait al-Maqdis.
Igisubizo kiri mu murongo aho Allah yemeye Mariyamu akamuha ibimutunga.

identity.label: Ndi nde?
options: Umuhanuzi witaga kuri Mariyamu mu rusengero
Umuhanuzi wavuganye na Allah mu buryo butaziguye

trial.label: Igeragezwa/Ikibazo
options: Kubona ibibatunga byatanzwe mu buryo bw'amayobera ku barwayi bakiri bato
Gutabwa mu cyobo n'abantu be bwite
trial.answer: Kubona ibibatunga byatanzwe mu buryo bw'amayobera ku barwayi bakiri bato

outcome.label: Ibisubizo
options: Kwemerwa n'Imana n'imbabazi zayo ku bantu biyeguriye gusenga
Umwana w'umuhungu yavutse ageze mu zabukuru nk'uko byari byasezeranijwe
outcome.answer: Kwemerwa n'Imana n'imbabazi zayo ku bantu biyeguriye gusenga

arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍۢ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًۭا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًۭا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verse: So her Lord accepted her with good acceptance and caused her to grow in a good manner and put her in the care of Zechariah. Every time Zechariah entered upon her in the prayer chamber, he found with her provision. He said, "O Mary, from where is this [coming] to you?" She said, "It is from Allāh. Indeed, Allāh provides for whom He wills without account." (3:37)
